title: Desktop
drDigitalIntro:
The desktop is the main screen you see when your computer turns on.
• It is your starting point for everything.
• Along the bottom is the dock — a row of icons for your most-used apps.
• You can put folders and files right on the desktop for quick access.
• Now look at your own screen. Can you see the dock at the bottom or the menu bar at the top? Take a moment to find them before you continue.
drDigitalSuccess: That's your desktop — home base for everything you do!
drDigitalHint: Take a look around the playground desktop on the right, then click Continue whenever you're ready.
